# CANDIDATE: DECOUPLE_LEVEL_STATE_IN_BULLISH_SETUP

**Filed:** 2026-07-08  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Decoupling the level state lookup from the reclaim level condition in `evaluate_bullish_setup` reduces false triggers by ensuring level state validity is assessed independently. This prepares for future wider-data probes by making the level state lookup more robust and less dependent on simultaneous reclaim conditions, potentially improving the signal quality of bullish reclaim setups without altering the core exit logic.

## Mechanism

Modify `evaluate_bullish_setup` in `backtest/lib/filters.py` to look up `level_state` from the level memory system without requiring the `reclaim_level` condition to be true at the same bar. Currently, the level state lookup may be gated by the reclaim level check. After the change, `level_state` is looked up independently (e.g., using the current bar or a fixed lookback) and then used in the setup evaluation alongside other conditions. Entry trigger logic remains: requires ≥2 of 3 (level reclaim, EMA ribbon flip, confluence). Exit logic unchanged (chart stop, chandelier profit-lock, premium stop, time stop).
